div.div: جِذِبَّانٌ The sandal-thong that is between the great and second toes. (K, TA.) You say, مَا أَغْنَى عَنِى جِذِبَّانًا He did not stand me in stead of, or avail me as much as, a sandal-thong that is between the great and second toes. (AA, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
